purpose: Preserve bounded visual-gate decisions as durable packets that can later be composed into progressively richer app/web views without silently converting local research results into final whole-system authority.

authority.adoption_basis: Director endorsed the packet-plus-later-whole-view model; Design Sol adopted the durable in-lane workflow under standing clean-recursive-audit delegation.

core_law: A visual gate should leave a durable packet whenever it creates, rejects, pauses, or provisionally selects a mechanism that may matter to later composition.
A packet preserves the local result and its exact authority limits; it is not an assertion that the whole app or website should already look like that packet in isolation.
Later composition and whole-app synthesis may reveal interactions that were impossible to judge locally. Those interactions are new evidence, not permission to rewrite the earlier packet silently.

If synthesis exposes a material conflict, open a bounded successor/refinement gate that cites the conflicting packet IDs and preserves the predecessor packet unchanged as historical/provisional evidence.

A final cross-surface visual system must not be claimed coherent merely by accumulating individually successful packets; whole-system synthesis and audit are required before final convergence or implementation-ready cross-surface authority is claimed.

GATE_MECHANISM_PACKET.purpose: Preserve one bounded visual-gate result, including positive survivor, zero-survivor closure, rejection, pause, or provisional mechanism.
GATE_MECHANISM_PACKET.does_not_create: Whole-app composition, final production tokens, implementation authority, or Phase-C convergence unless the governing gate separately grants them.

COMPOSITION_PACKET.purpose: Combine two or more existing gate packets on one bounded representative surface to test their interaction without changing the component packets by implication.
examples: motion plus color-role logic on one neutral app surface
typography plus spacing plus control-state treatment
COMPOSITION_PACKET.authority: Integration evidence only unless a separately authorized refinement/adjudication promotes a change.

WHOLE_APP_SYNTHESIS_PACKET.purpose: Assemble the current relevant mechanism packets into a representative whole-app/cross-surface view and audit system coherence, gaps, collisions, and refinement pressure.
WHOLE_APP_SYNTHESIS_PACKET.activation: Only when CURRENT_STATE/roadmap/Director opens the integration gate or when whole-system coherence is required before a claimed convergence/implementation handoff.
WHOLE_APP_SYNTHESIS_PACKET.authority: May confirm compatibility, expose integration conflicts, and open targeted successor gates. It may not retroactively alter packet history or invent outside-lane product/engineering authority.

packet_statuses.FROZEN_LOCAL_RESULT: Gate result is frozen but not necessarily a selected incumbent.
packet_statuses.PROVISIONAL_INCUMBENT: Current preferred mechanism for later integration; not final production authority.
packet_statuses.CLOSED_ZERO_SURVIVORS: Gate closed without a survivor; preserve the negative result and gap.
packet_statuses.PAUSED: Research is intentionally paused; no incumbent is implied.
packet_statuses.DIRECTOR_ADJUDICATION_PENDING: Mechanical/Design Sol work is complete and a genuine Director taste/product-meaning choice remains.
packet_statuses.INTEGRATION_REVIEW_REQUIRED: A later composition exposed a material interaction that requires a new bounded gate.
packet_statuses.SUPERSEDED_BY_SUCCESSOR: A later explicitly authorized packet replaces the packet for current use; predecessor remains preserved.

director_review_surface_law.principle: A visual decision must be reviewable visually without requiring the Director to inspect diagnostic data formats.
requirements: When the decision is visual, the packet must identify an obvious human-viewable surface such as index.html, canonical PNG/contact sheet, deterministic animation page, or other directly reviewable artifact.
JSON may carry evidence, provenance, and machine diagnostics but must not be the only Director-facing representation of a visual alternative.
Accessibility variants such as forced-colors or reduced-motion evidence must be labeled as validation evidence rather than presented as competing aesthetic options.
Raw DOM dumps, console logs, and machine reports are diagnostics, not visual evidence unless the governing question is specifically about those diagnostics.
If a ZIP is supplied, include a top-level README and a plainly named entry point when feasible; if no HTML entry point exists, state exactly which image/media files should be opened.

required_dimensions_when_applicable: shared-brand coherence across APP and WEB without forced identical composition
implementation feasibility and truthful engineering boundary
whether removing/simplifying a packet makes the whole stronger
open visual-system gaps that no current packet legitimately answers

allowed_reasons: changed product/engineering truth that materially affects the visual mechanism
not_allowed: preference drift without a declared new taste decision
rewriting a prior packet to make later synthesis appear inevitable
treating an attractive whole-app mockup as automatic authority over frozen local evidence

drive_relationship: GitHub stores packet law, decision records, machine evidence and reproducible prototypes. Google Drive Ensemble Project remains canonical for visual-master binaries, high-fidelity mockups, motion studies and artwork provenance. A composition/synthesis derivative never silently becomes a master or final incumbent.
non_authority: This framework does not itself select any current CLR-01 family.
It does not reopen TYP-01, hero research, O3, Threshold K, Mineral Theater, F1A/CS2 cadence, or any closed experiment.
It does not authorize application implementation, website production/deployment, final tokens, final identity, or Phase-C convergence.
It does not change Ensemble-Project product/engineering authority.
